description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code managing UI interactions, including button click handlers for actions like sign-up, login, playlist creation, and mock playback controls. It also includes helper functions for DOM selection and event handling, and comments about future data injection.

methods.name: qs(sel, el = document)
methods.description: Helper function for document.querySelector or element.querySelector

methods.name: qsa(sel, el = document)
methods.description: Helper function for document.querySelectorAll converted to Array

ctags.name: qs
ctags.pattern: /^  function qs(sel, el = document) { return el.querySelector(sel); }$/

ctags.name: qsa
ctags.pattern: /^  function qsa(sel, el = document) { return Array.from(el.querySelectorAll(sel)); }$/
